description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of narrative media framing in political discourse across three distinct categories, with the largest segment, colored blue, accounting for 46.0% (46 units) and labeled as the dominant category. The orange segment, representing 33.0% (33 units), is labeled “2018,” while the green segment, at 21.0% (21 units), is labeled “2017.” A small gray segment is present at the top of the chart but lacks a label or numerical value, suggesting it may represent an unclassified or residual category. The chart uses color-coded slices with percentage and raw count labels inside each segment, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size clockwise from the top. No legend is provided, but the labels are directly associated with their respective slices. The visual emphasis on the blue segment suggests it is the primary focus of the data distribution.
